title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Sandia Casino Amphitheater, Albuquerque | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Sandia Casino Amphitheater in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA, on 2 July 2006.

It was the 13th show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr had previously performed at the Sandia Casino Amphitheater on 25 August 2003. He returned there on 9 July 2014.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion

  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
